Suggestion: Here’s a simpler version of your sentence for a Grade 8 readability level:

**"Steven Mathew is a full-stack and AI developer. He is also the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at 7Steps AI in Toronto."**

This version keeps the key details while making it easier to understand.
Pro: Author bio present with clear expertise in Full Stack and AI Development
Pro: Detailed description of services and specializations
Pro: Portfolio showcasing diverse projects and technologies
Pro: Mentions of specific technologies and frameworks (Next.js, React, WordPress)
Con: No visible author credentials or certifications
Con: No visible dates or timestamps on portfolio items to demonstrate recent work
Con: No visible client testimonials or case studies
Con: No visible privacy policy or terms of service
Con: No visible about page or detailed company information
Con: No visible blog or articles section with published dates
